requested_by: 동동, 2026-10-23 '코인 수 늘려봐' (after the strategy-search review recommended a few economically motivated hypotheses on a broad universe)
question: On a broad, point-in-time universe of Binance USDT-M perpetuals, does any of four cross-sectional hypotheses with a known economic story earn a positive return after assumed costs on DEV data only?
scope: DEV only. No validation, locked, paper or IW1 window. No criteria change. Results are research notes; nothing here is promoted or sent to a validation window.

universe.source: every USDT-quoted symbol under data/futures/um/monthly/klines/ of the public Binance archive (S3 mirror), including symbols delisted later (no survivorship filter)
universe.exclude: stable or fiat bases (USDC, BUSD, TUSD, FDUSD, USDP, DAI, USDE, EUR, GBP, AEUR) and index contracts (names containing DOM or DEFI)
universe.point_in_time_rule: at each rebalance: symbols with at least 60 complete daily bars before the signal cut-off, ranked by mean daily quote volume over the 30 days before the cut-off; keep the top 50
universe.segment_rule: BTCUSDT is not read in S2 (BTC locked TEST/paper era, ADR 0019); every other symbol obeys the never_read list

S1.use: the only segment that decides anything

S2.use: reported only, never used to choose

never_read: BTC validation/locked TEST + embargo, all symbols
timing: rebalance every Monday at the 00:00 UTC daily open. Signals use daily bars that closed by Sunday 00:00 UTC (one day skipped, against bid-ask bounce and look-ahead). Positions are held 7 days to the next rebalance.
portfolio: long the 10 best and short the 10 worst of the 50 by the hypothesis signal, equal weight, +1/20 and -1/20 of capital per name (gross 1, net 0). Ties broken by symbol name.
missing_data: never filled. A held symbol with no daily bar earns 0 that day and is closed at the next rebalance at its last close; such days are counted and reported (delisting losses may be missed).

hypotheses.story: cross-sectional momentum: slow diffusion of information / trend chasing across coins
short-term reversal: liquidity providers paid for absorbing one-week overreaction
funding carry: crowded longs pay funding; short high-funding and long low-funding coins and collect the difference
hypotheses.signal: mean settled funding rate per 8h over the 7 days to the cut-off (rates of 1h/4h symbols scaled to 8h)

hypotheses.story: low-volatility anomaly: lottery demand overprices volatile coins
hypotheses.signal: standard deviation of the last 30 daily returns to the cut-off

trials: exactly these 4, each run once. A new family on new data (broad universe), recorded in run/audit/dev_search_trials.jsonl. The report also shows the deflation against the cumulative count of earlier DEV searches for reference.

cost.profile: assumed_public_v1 (taker 5bp + half spread 2bp + slippage 3bp + 0.1*sqrt(10,000 USDT / quote volume of the 15m bar before execution), every side), charged on each name's absolute weight change at every rebalance with an order value of 10,000 USDT per name
cost.impact_bar: the 23:45-00:00 UTC 15m bar before the Monday open, read from the 15m archive; if that bar is missing the day's quote volume / 96 is used and counted
cost.participation: a name whose order would exceed 5% of that bar is still traded but flagged and counted (the profile's max participation), not dropped
cost.funding: actual settled funding on every held position (short receives positive funding)
cost.status: ASSUMED. Alt order books are being measured (ends about 2026-10-27); the run will be repeated once with the measured cost and counted as a new run of the same 4.

statistics.unit: daily portfolio return, entry-day booking, simple sum
statistics.report: annualised Sharpe, annual return, max drawdown, t of mean, beta and correlation to the equal-weight universe, beta-adjusted mean and its t, S1 halves, S2, sensitivity rows, turnover per rebalance, cost share
statistics.dev_flag_not_a_verdict: DEV_PROMISING only if, under assumed cost: S1 annual Sharpe above the expected maximum of 4 unskilled trials over the S1 length, S1 beta-adjusted mean t >= 2, both S1 halves positive, and S2 annual Sharpe > 0.5. Anything else is NOT_PROMISING. The flag never opens a window; a DEV_PROMISING hypothesis can only be proposed for a new preregistered forward window.
